name: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly ↗ A shallow raised grass lawn, only 3-4 pixels
lower_description: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly a flat solid muted medium green #43894f, with extremely sparse tiny 1-2 pixel grass strokes in #4e9557 and #397d48. Simple clean low-detail cozy farming-game pixel art, 16x16 tiles. Match this dark normal grass as the lower ground. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front edge, ground top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No flowers, stones, weeds, bushes, shadows from objects or outlines around tiles.
upper_description: A shallow raised grass lawn, only 3-4 pixels high. Its flat upper surface must be almost the SAME green as the existing normal meadow: dominant colour #4a9757 (RGB 74,151,87), only 10 percent brighter than normal #43894f (RGB 67,137,79). At least 90 percent of the flat top uses #4a9757; extremely sparse isolated 1-2 pixel tufts only. No pale lime, yellow green, pastel mint, bleached or strongly contrasting top. The silhouette is ORGANIC AND VERY WAVY like a natural pond shoreline: small irregular lobes and inward nicks, wandering edges with 2-4 pixel lateral offsets every few pixels, smoothly rounded convex and concave corners. No geometric rectangles or straight block corners. Low muted earthy vertical bank under the turf lip. Cozy 16px farming-game pixel art matching the connected normal grass. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No objects, flowers, rocks or large tufts.
transition_description: A low earthy bank with a dark green turf lip, following a crooked, scalloped natural shoreline. Deliberately meandering S-curves, uneven rounded protrusions and small inset bays, like the project pond grass border. Vary the silhouette by 2-4 pixels inside EVERY edge tile so neighboring tiles never form a ruler-straight line. Rounded and irregular convex/concave corners, never 90-degree square corners. Only a narrow dark contact shadow. Keep banks shallow and preserve seamless corner matching.

target_palette.name: Subtle raised meadow: normal #43894f, upper #4a9757 (about ten percent lighter), muted earth banks
